note: Hand-written from PHOIBLE and the Chirp 3 HD phoneme tables; first draft 2026-10-03. Symbols are the phonemic set an entry may use; the display and the engine input share it.
conventions: Standard Ukrainian. Palatalization is written with ʲ after the consonant (tʲ dʲ sʲ zʲ tsʲ dzʲ nʲ lʲ rʲ). Written г is ɦ, ґ is ɡ, и is ɪ, е is ɛ, о is ɔ. Unstressed vowels are written with their full value, no reduction. Length ː is used only to mark a doubled consonant.
